# Paid Time Off Policy — United States

Full-time US employees accrue 15 days of PTO per year, accrued monthly at 1.25 days/month.
Up to 5 unused days carry over into the next year; anything beyond is forfeited on Dec 31.

New hires begin accruing PTO from day one but cannot use it until completing a 30-day waiting
period. PTO requests must be submitted in the HR portal at least 5 business days in advance for
anything longer than 2 days.

Blackout periods: no PTO during the last week of each fiscal quarter close (last week of March,
June, September, December) for Finance and Sales teams.

Contact hr-us@alderbrooksystems.example with questions.
